mentions.name: Nift
mentions.description: A lightweight, fully keyboard-based note-taking app where notes are one-liners with minimal Markdown support. It manages tasks and reminders, does inline calculations, offers unlimited undo/redo, and organizes notes by project and categories, storing data as simple text files. The core focus is simplicity, frictionless high-performance note taking, and an open nature, with plans for a framework supporting kanban, Eisenhower matrix, back-linking, bookmark manager, and time-tracking views.
mentions.problem: Note-taking interfaces that require mouse use and UI that interrupts writing thoughts and breaks muscle memory.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a lightweight, note taking application that focuses on quick note taking, and fully keyboard based usage.
mentions.author: t_mahmood
